environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task but with a custom task definition specifying linuxParameters.capabilities with dropped ALL and added only NET_BIND_SERVICE, plus a custom seccomp profile loaded via the task definition's dockerSecurityOpt equivalent (pidMode=task, seccomp profile baked into AMI at /etc/ecs/seccomp/report-service.json). The seccomp profile is based on the default docker profile but removes execve, execveat, clone3 (for new process creation), and forkexec-related calls from the whitelist. Additionally, the container runs as UID 1000 (non-root) with readOnlyRootFilesystem=true and tmpfs mounted only at /tmp/reports with noexec,nosuid,size=50m mount options.
